title: Slack Socket Mode app_token renewal -- invalid_auth symptom and fix
desc: Eye Slack WebSocket drops with invalid_auth when the xapp-1 app-level token is revoked. Symptom: Eye log shows Slack reconnect failed invalid_auth, Slack=False msgs=0. Token in webhook.json must be regenerated at api.slack.com.
steps: 1. api.slack.com/apps -> WKAppBot -> Basic Information -> App-Level Tokens. 2. Delete old token, generate new one with connections:write scope. 3. Copy xapp-1-... token. 4. Update app_token in bin/wkappbot.hq/profiles/slack_exp/webhook.json. 5. Eye auto-reconnects within 5s. Verify: EYE_LOOP shows Slack=True.
author: claude
